milestone: OIP v2.2E.0 — Production Evidence Authority & Migration Health Readiness Requalification

roadmap.canonical_next_identity: OIP v2.2E — Controlled Production Migration Preflight
roadmap.canonical_status: Restart at Phase 1: no production migration state was created by the earlier failed-closed preflight.
roadmap.required_precondition: Production Evidence activation/authority must be explicitly configured and supervised before a migration can begin.
roadmap.five_thousand_scale: Not authorized. The canonical 5,000-attempt expansion remains downstream of bounded production authority activation, measured Evidence write load, and rollback qualification.

production_health.queue: No actionable Creator Funding rows observed after a freshly completed LIVE item.
production_health.database: Current Creator Funding heartbeat DB p99 is 3–4ms; this is a point health signal, not an interval percentile.

migration_identity.identity: mint plus non-null migration signature; persistence uses idempotent token/migration checks
migration_identity.consumer: Creator Funding, operational projections and downstream intelligence

creator_identity.precedence: earliest_tx_creator is the resolved transaction-derived creator when present; pf_ws_creator remains separately preserved as listener provenance. A disagreement is not silently merged.

creator_funding.semantics: creator-global, set-valued and amount-accumulating positive funding evidence. No row is not proof of NO_FUNDING; pending, partial, failed and timeout states remain distinct.

outgoing.semantics: outgoing acquisition remains synchronous before Creator Funding terminal completion. Zero rows must not be normalized as proven zero outgoing transfers without completeness evidence.

jito_debridge_axiom_second_hop_network.semantics: derived projections must retain their authoritative input and completeness state.

evidence_platform.live_authority: NONE — default Evidence database is absent and all discovered candidates are pilot/staged/frozen/shadow corpora.
evidence_platform.mirror_contract: Optional shared-acquisition observer; passive and non-waiting. It mirrors completed responses only, performs no RPC, spools bounded handoff failures, and is disabled in production.
evidence_platform.writer_contract: Single controlled Evidence writer with bounded batches, idempotent envelopes, commit-before-ack and isolated Evidence paths; no live supervised owner is configured.

equivalence_and_semantics.live_sample: NOT_RUN — there is no live Evidence authority and activating one is outside E.0. This is an explicit bounded pre-activation exclusion, not a silent loss claim.
equivalence_and_semantics.zero_silent_loss: PASS at contract-test level; mirror, normalization, identity/raw-artifact, primitive and runtime boundary regressions passed.
equivalence_and_semantics.false_negative_rule: PASS at contract level: Evidence is append-only and records provenance/quality; production missing funding or outgoing data is not permitted to become a negative fact. Live proof is an activation acceptance gate.
equivalence_and_semantics.provider_disagreement: Preservation is covered by immutable normalization tests; no new provider calls were made.

coverage_baseline.note: Existing OIP coverage is staged/shadow, not production authority. Migration, creator, funding, normalized Evidence, primitive and operation-evaluation coverage remain separate denominators; no single percentage is asserted.

worktree_reproducibility: B — IDENTIFIED_WITH_MINOR_AMBIGUITY. The live Creator Funding worker is healthy but the implementation/audits are uncommitted. Consolidate before a restart or any deployment-bearing activation.

decisions.migration_authority_health: PASS for bounded activation readiness; no existing production Evidence authority is claimed.
decisions.creator_funding_dependency: PASS — X78.40 remains authoritative and healthy.
decisions.database_and_rpc_dependency: PASS for the next bounded activation gate.
decisions.broad_migration_or_5000_scale: HOLD — requires first bounded production Evidence authority activation and measured write/load qualification.

next_milestone: OIP v2.2E — Controlled Production Migration Preflight, Phase 1: explicitly configure a separate production Evidence authority, supervise its writer lifecycle, and run bounded default-off-to-shadow activation with fail-open rollback before any migration or 5,000-scale work.
